short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in Porter Ranch.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Porter Ranch. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Porter Ranch, including Porter Ranch, The Vineyards at Porter Ranch, Sesnon Oaks, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Porter Ranch?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Porter Ranch building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Porter Ranch?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Porter Ranch rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Porter Ranch remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
